Description.English: Under the influence of a strong northeast monsoon, northerly winds will strengthen significantly, reaching force 6 with strong gust, and the temperature will drop accordingly, starting on Monday (9th Nov). The minimum temperature will drop to around 16 degrees Celsius between Tuesday and Wednesday (10th to 11th Nov). Due to significant diurnal temperature variations and dry conditions, the public is advised to take appropriate measures and be cautious of fire.( Update Time: 2026-11-09 00H05 )
